title: Book Three · Chapter 194: The Months Between
story:
A few days after Ronan's nineteenth birthday, the centre sends the full year calendar.

The first teaching term runs from late July to late November. The second runs from late March to late July afterward.

Between them is a long winter break. The shared rooms close during that break. Students need their own plan for those months.

Ronan puts the calendar beside his cost sheet.

“Home,” he says to Mum and Dad.

Dad looks at the two term dates.

“We need the actual return days nearer the time.”

“And the fares,” Ronan says.

At the present prices, two long journeys and two local bus rides would cost forty-two yuan. He marks that amount as a travel reserve, not a payment already made.

Mum points to the break on the calendar.

“You can eat here. We will plan the household food before we put more aside.”

Ronan nods. He will not need a paid room at the coast through those months. The family will check the home budget again when the dates are close.

He folds the calendar with both term pages inside. The food figures on his study sheet cover eight teaching months. The months at home belong in the household plan.

Later that week, Leo's twenty-fifth reply arrives.

His three months of part-time shop work are complete. He has chosen to stay in his own city for more work and learning. The new arrangement will keep him there during July.

He cannot come back for Ronan's departure. He writes that clearly, then asks for the centre's postal address.

Send the real address, he adds. I cannot put a letter in the sea.

Ronan laughs and reads the line to Dad.

“A wet reply,” Dad says.

“A very slow one.”

He puts Leo's letter beside the birthday book. The address paper and the class photo are still inside that book.

That evening, Ronan takes the blue bike out along the quiet road. At the busy corner, he gets off and pushes.

He rides a short loop through the park, with the old bell above his hand. He has time for only one circle before dinner, so he turns back at the far tree.

At home, he parks the bike beside the wall. Mum is setting the table. Ronan washes his hands and brings the last bowl from the shelf while Dad finds a clear place for the new calendar. Then he sits between them for the meal.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

calendar＝日期安排表；departure＝出发；postal address＝通信地址；reserve＝备用金、预留。

## 理解问题

1. 两段四个月教学之间住哪里？四十二元是已买的票，还是待复核的预留？
2. Leo为什么不临时出现在送行现场？第二十五封回复是否已真实到达？

## 读句子

**The shared rooms close during that break.**

拆开看：The shared rooms / close / during that break.

合住宿舍／关闭不供居住／在那段长假期间。
